import json, subprocess, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp')
from check import decode
from audit import audit
TESTS = [
    ("erase all", {"initial": [["::/0", 1], ["::1/128", 2], ["::2/128", 3]],
                   "transactions": [[["erase", "::/0"], ["erase", "::1/128"], ["erase", "::2/128"]]],
                   "bursts": [{"version": 1, "repeat": 4, "addresses": ["::", "::5"]}],
                   "cache_pages": 2, "costs": {"hit": 1, "miss": 8, "decode": [0, 1, 2]}}),
    ("re-add after erase", {"initial": [["::/0", 1]],
                            "transactions": [[["erase", "::/0"]], [["set", "::/0", 9]], []],
                            "bursts": [{"version": 0, "repeat": 2, "addresses": ["::"]},
                                       {"version": 1, "repeat": 2, "addresses": ["::"]},
                                       {"version": 2, "repeat": 2, "addresses": ["::"]},
                                       {"version": 3, "repeat": 2, "addresses": ["::"]}],
                            "cache_pages": 3, "costs": {"hit": 3, "miss": 7, "decode": [1, 0, 2]}}),
    ("nested reveal", {"initial": [["::/0", 1], ["2000::/1", 2], ["2000::/2", 3],
                                   ["2000::/4", 4], ["2000::/8", 5]],
                       "transactions": [[["erase", "2000::/4"]], [["erase", "2000::/2"]],
                                        [["erase", "2000::/1"]]],
                       "bursts": [{"version": 3, "repeat": 6, "addresses": ["2000::", "2000::4"]}],
                       "cache_pages": 1, "costs": {"hit": 1, "miss": 30, "decode": [0, 0, 0]}}),
    ("hop zero and null", {"initial": [["::/0", 0], ["::/128", 0]],
                           "transactions": [[["erase", "::/0"]]],
                           "bursts": [{"version": 1, "repeat": 9, "addresses": ["::", "::1"]}],
                           "cache_pages": 4, "costs": {"hit": 2, "miss": 2, "decode": [3, 3, 3]}}),
]
for name, case in TESTS:
    req = {"cases": [case]}
    payload = json.dumps(req).encode()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=payload,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if p.returncode:
        print('FAIL %-20s %s' % (name, p.stderr[:300])); continue
    actual = decode(p.stdout)
    try:
        audit(req, actual, actual)
        print('PASS %-20s objective=%s changes=%s' %
              (name, actual["cases"][0]["objective"],
               len(actual["cases"][0]["changes"])))
    except Exception as e:
        print('FAIL %-20s %r' % (name, e))
EOF
